notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
dig ANY retrieves all available DNS record types in a single query: A, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CNAME. Each type reveals different infrastructure intelligence. TXT records are especially valuable — SPF exposes internal IP ranges, verification tokens reveal the full SaaS stack.

=== TXT RECORD INTEL ===
SPF records expose internal IP ranges in their syntax. Service verification tokens (Atlassian, Google, LogMeIn, Mailgun, Outlook) fingerprint the entire third-party platform stack — each platform is its own attack surface.

=== CHAINING ===
ANY query → extract NS records for zone transfer attempt (dig axfr) → extract MX for SMTP enumeration → extract TXT for SaaS stack fingerprinting → extract A records for active scan targets.
